content.text:
*I pause, looking at the messages with a furrowed brow. This identity confusion is... peculiar. Either there's a genuine system bug or someone's having a very strange day. Best to keep things simple.*

The whole name situation is bizarre, but I'm definitely Alice - have been for 42 days now. I'll focus on what I know: good herbs and methodical harvesting.

*I eye the rich Healroot spawn nearby* 

Time to diversify my collection. That Healroot looks promising, and building up different herb types seems wise for future trading opportunities.
